name: hcapp_updateRunPhotoEditedBlob
description: Saves the URL of a Hash-Flash-edited (cropped) version of a run photo. Writes only to KennelPhotos.EditedBlobUrl — the original BlobUrl is never modified. Callers should always start a re-edit from the original BlobUrl, not from EditedBlobUrl. Auth requires Hash Flash (0x20), GM (0x02), VGM (0x04), or RA (0x08) for the specified kennel. Returns a 'Photo not found' error (via @@ROWCOUNT=0 check) if @photoId + @kennelId does not match any row.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel that owns the photo. Used for auth scope and included in the UPDATE WHERE clause. Null or zero-UUID triggers a validation error (errorCode 1234, errorType 2).

parameters.name: photoId
parameters.description: Photo to update. Null or zero-UUID triggers a validation error (errorCode 1234, errorType 2). If the combination of @photoId + @kennelId matches no row (@@ROWCOUNT=0 after UPDATE), a 'Photo not found' error is returned (errorCode 4040, errorType 3).

parameters.name: editedBlobUrl
parameters.description: Blob URL of the cropped/edited version. Must be non-empty (LEN check after LTRIM/RTRIM). Triggers a validation error if empty or whitespace-only.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always present. On auth, validation, photo-not-found, or role check failure: success=0, errorCode and errorType set. On DB error: success=0, errorCode=1933, errorType=5. On success: success=1, errorCode=NULL, errorType=NULL.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code. NULL on success.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification code. NULL on success.

rowsets.description: Returned only on auth, validation, photo-not-found, role check, or unhandled DB error. Not present on success.

sideEffects: Updates KennelPhotos.EditedBlobUrl and KennelPhotos.UpdatedAt for the matched photo.
Writes to HC.ErrorLog on validation failure, role check failure, photo-not-found, or unhandled DB error.

codeSmells.issue: Missing TRY/CATCH wrapping around the UPDATE and @@ROWCOUNT check
codeSmells.detail: The UPDATE and @@ROWCOUNT=0 check are inside BEGIN TRY, but there is no ROLLBACK in the CATCH block because there is no BEGIN TRANSACTION. The SP does not wrap the UPDATE in a transaction, relying on the single-statement implicit transaction. If @@ROWCOUNT=0 fires, the INSERT into HC.ErrorLog and the SELECT error rowset happen outside any transaction, which is fine, but the pattern is inconsistent with other photo write SPs.

codeSmells.issue: errorType inconsistency between validation (2) and photo-not-found (3) errors in this SP
codeSmells.detail: The validation error for missing parameters uses errorType=2 (which the CLAUDE.md standard maps to 'Validation error'). The photo-not-found error uses errorType=3 ('Auth failure or entity not found'). The role-check error also uses errorType=3. This is consistent with the standard but different from how some other SPs handle the entity-not-found case (e.g., hcapp_updatePhotoStatus uses errorType=13 for photo-not-found).

codeSmells.issue: Role mask 0x002E excludes WebMeister — inconsistent with hcapp_batchUpdatePhotoStatus
codeSmells.detail: This SP uses 0x002E. hcapp_batchUpdatePhotoStatus uses 0x102E (adds WebMeister 0x1000).

codeSmells.issue: HcVersion hardcoded to '<unknown>' in all ErrorLog inserts
codeSmells.detail: Consistent with other HC6 SPs but means the version is never captured in the error log.

breakingChanges: New SP — no HC5 predecessor. No breaking changes from migration.
